item: A bulletin introduction shows a dash, not the word None, for a figure the edition did not carry
summary: Bulletin: the introduction's figures (days, articles, corpus articles, contributing sources) printed the word None when the edition's masthead did not carry one; they now print a dash, as the section tables already did. Also: custody's redirected-path JSON write goes through atomic_replace (R176) instead of one fixed temp name, and the settings-store tests now pin the plain error class, the from None, and migration. Bulletin introductions show — instead of None for a missing figure.
